title: feat(console): from 768 px up a sign-in lands in the last-used app, and the platform home page retires
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ86SdD9VQ1FhbW2NBgnZqcmq)_

Fixes #36732
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：电脑端（768 像素以上）登录、单点登录回跳、输入旧的首页地址，都直接进入上次用的应用；没有记录时进入声明为默认的应用，再没有就进第一个业务应用；一个应用都没有的人看到「还没有应用」页，能直接用 AI 搭建、从模板开始或去应用市场；管理员没做完的设置清单搬到系统设置首页最上方；手机端不变。
- 为什么做：平台首页第二阶段（电脑端去掉平台首页），让员工登录后直接落到干活的应用里，少一次点击。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是登录后落到不想去的应用，换应用一次点击即可，登录前带的深链接不受影响；整个 PR 可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

From 768 px up there is no platform home page any more. A sign-in, the SSO round trip, `/` and the old `/home` address land in an app the viewer's permission sets show (`/me/apps`, the launcher's answer), in this order: the app the viewer last had open (while it is still active and not hidden for them); else the app the product declares `isDefault`; else the first app somebody put into the environment (never Setup, Studio or Account, by `isPlatformBuiltinApp`).

- `ui/apps/console/src/components/RootLandingRedirect.tsx`: new `resolveDesktopLandingPath(apps, lastApp)`; the last-app preference wait now applies at every width; an optional `home` element is drawn in place when the desktop resolves to `/home`. `resolvePhoneLandingPath` and `resolveLandingPath` keep the phone's rules exactly.
- Contract review S1 (dcbc1ea2): from 768 px up `/` hands off to `/home`, the one desktop resolver, because `/home` sits inside `LauncherAppsProvider` and `/` does not; `RootLandingRedirect` narrows by `useServedApps` and waits on the first `/me/apps` read (`useLauncherApps().pending`). `useHomePath` narrows the same way; Home's `desktopNoApps` reads `launcher.apps`. A set-hidden app is never the landing, the Home target, or counted as the viewer's product app.
- Contract review r2 (comment 7106639199): outside `LauncherAppsProvider` (`/studio/*`, `/ai/*`) and while its first `/me/apps` read is out, `useServedApps` passes the list unnarrowed, so from 768 px up `useHomePath` now names `/home` (the narrowed resolver) unless `useServedAppsSettled()` reports a held answer. Pinned on the real provider in `useHomePath.servedAnswer-36732.test.tsx`; the phone branch is unchanged. `RedirectWithSplash` now carries navigation state, and the `/` and `/home` hops pass it on, so an old `/ai` address's Builder handoff survives the `/home` hop.
- `ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx`: `HomeRoute` returns the page on a phone and `RootLandingRedirect home={page}` from 768 px up, so `/home` lands the same way `/` does.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/homePath.ts` + `hooks/useHomePath.ts`: `resolveDesktopHomePath(apps, lastApp)` (exported), the same order, read by ⌘⇧H, the way back from a missing app, Studio's way out, the header home mark and the app switcher. Held equal to the console resolver by a new parity block in `landingHomeParity-7256.test.ts`.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx`: a viewer with no product app now gets only the no-apps empty state on desktop: 「No applications yet」 and, for a viewer who may add an app, the sidebar app menu's 「Add app」 doors as buttons (build with AI or new in Studio, start from a template, the app marketplace). An admin without `manage_metadata` gets the capability reason (#8270's copy); anyone else the existing member copy. The first-run checklist stays above it.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useAddAppEntries.ts` (new): the 「Add app」 entries and their gate, extracted from `SidebarAppMenu.tsx` so the menu and the empty state read one list.
- `ui/packages/auth/src/LoginForm.tsx`: the SSO callback is the console root instead of `/home`.
- `ui/packages/i18n`: `home.noAppsAddDescription` in all 11 console locales ("Build your first app, or start from a template or the app marketplace."; zh-Hant generated by `gen:zh-hant`).
- Item 5 (the maintainer's pick, option A, recorded on the card in comment 7105083177): an administrator's first-run checklist, while it has open items, sits at the top of the Setup app's first page. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/setupFirstPageSlot.tsx` (new) is the host slot (`SetupFirstPageSlotProvider`, exported) plus `isLandingPath`; `AppContent.tsx`'s `SetupFirstPageTop` draws the slot above the route only in Setup, only from 768 px up, and only on the page Setup's root lands on for this member (the same `resolveLandingRoute` over the same member-shown trees `AppRootLanding` reads, so a re-ordered Setup navigation moves it). Where drawn, the page scrolls as one column: checklist, then the page at full height. The two wrappers are the same on every route (N4), so moving onto or off the first page does not remount the routes. `ui/apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx` hands `FirstRunChecklist placement="top"` to the slot; the checklist's own rules (admins only, hidden once done, dismissable) are unchanged. The no-apps empty state keeps it through Home's slot.
- Item 6 (bell count): already `unreadTopics + pendingApprovalsCount` in `InboxPopover`, so unchanged.

Read first, by risk: `RootLandingRedirect.tsx` (the wait now gates desktop too), `app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` (`SetupFirstPageTop`, wraps every Setup route), `homePath.ts` (`resolveDesktopHomePath`).

Two-minute check: on a fresh environment sign in at 1280 px wide and open Setup: the 「Get your system ready」 card is above System Overview; open any other Setup page and it is gone.

## Tests

- New: `RootLandingRedirect.test.ts` (`resolveDesktopLandingPath`), `RootLandingRedirect.route.test.tsx` (desktop lands in the last app, waits for the preference, the retired `/home` address, 4 cases), `landingHomeParity-7256.test.ts` (desktop parity over app lists × last-app records), `useHomePath.test.tsx` (phone and desktop), `utils/__tests__/homePath.test.ts`, `LoginForm.test.tsx` (SSO callback), `HomePage.desktopNoApps-36732.test.tsx` (5 cases: AI door, Studio door without an agent, capability reason, member copy, not drawn once a product app exists), `AppContent.setupFirstPage-36732.test.tsx` (7 cases: drawn above the page Setup's root lands on and on a direct visit with a query; not on Setup's other pages, another app's same route, a phone, or with no host slot; `isLandingPath`).
- Updated to the new desktop behaviour: `StudioRoute`, `AppContent.deniedVsUnpublished`, `AppHeader.homeMark-12605`, `AppSwitcher.homeMenu-12605` (Home now resolves to an app); four App/FormPage route tests and four HomePage zero-app tests run at phone width, where `/home` is still the app list.

<details><summary>Local runs (under os-verify-lock)</summary>

- 8 previously failing files: Test Files 8 passed (8), Tests 107 passed (107).
- `HomePage.desktopNoApps-36732` + `AppContent.deniedVsUnpublished` + `homePath`: Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 42 passed (42).
- `packages/i18n`: Test Files 106 passed (106), Tests 1978 passed, 13 skipped.
- Item 5: `AppContent.setupFirstPage-36732` 7 passed (7). Ablation: with the Setup and landing-page gates removed from `SetupFirstPageTop`, 2 of 7 fail ("draws nothing on Setup's other pages", "draws nothing on another app's first page"); restored.
- S1 at dcbc1ea2: `RootLandingRedirect.route` 31 passed (31), 4 new set-hidden cases (first app it shows, a now-hidden last app skipped, every product app hidden gives the no-apps page, waits on the first read); ablation with the resolver back on the raw list: 4 failed. `useHomePath` set-hidden case. `AppContent.setupFirstPage-36732` 8 passed (8), the new no-remount case red on the old fragment-or-div shape. `HomePage.myWork-12602` desktop drafts-row pin (N3).
- Wide run at dcbc1ea2 (app-shell `AppContent*`, every Home test, console components and `App*`, `FirstRunChecklist`, `packages/i18n`, `useHomePath`, `homePath`, home mark, app switcher, sidebar app menu, `LoginForm`): Test Files 284, Tests 3654 passed + 13 skipped, after regenerating zh-Hant (the one red, `zh-hant-generated`, then 11/11).
- Neighbours at 5317dbf4: every `app-shell` `AppContent*` test, the console `AppContent*`, `FirstRunChecklist`, `firstRunChecklist*` and `App.homePermissions-12700` tests: Test Files 57 passed (57), Tests 561 passed (561).
- Gates, exit 0: `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `check:test-source-alias` (after adding the `@objectstack/lint` warm import to two edited test files), `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:role-word`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:published-files`, `check-sdui-manifest`.
- Type check: NOT MEASURED locally as a verdict. The UI `type-check` scripts need the built `@object-ui/*` declarations this container lacks, so output was filtered to touched files; one real error in this diff (`isProductApp` parameter type) was fixed, the rest are unresolved-module noise. CI's Type Check UI is the verdict.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Item 5 is built per the maintainer's pick (A). The checklist is not drawn on a phone. A phone admin with apps saw no checklist before this PR either: since #35881 the phone's `/home` is the app list alone. That is unchanged here and not in scope.
- Item 2: the console has no magic-link sign-in; the email-domain SSO callback is the path that went to `/home`, and it now goes to the root.
- The last app may be Setup (any app the viewer can still open counts), as in `desktop-03`.
- Contract review notes not acted on here: N1 (the email-domain SSO round trip never carried a pre-login `?redirect=`, before or after this PR) is a known gap, filed as #36754; N5's 2 s wait for the last-app record with no browser copy is the phone's existing behaviour, now shared; N3's dropped Ask AI action on the desktop no-apps page follows design board 45's three doors.
- Phone: unchanged by construction (phone resolvers untouched) and by screenshot.

## Verification

Browser, local showcase stack (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` + console Vite dev server), seeded admin, 1280×800 and 375×812, on head c2000776 (items 1-4) and 5317dbf4 (item 5); re-run at dcbc1ea2 with identical landings (`r2-` frames), plus `r2-desktop-06-set-hidden-app-not-landed`: Showcase recorded as the last app but dropped from `/me/apps` only, sign-in lands on `/home` with the no-apps page instead of opening it. Screenshots are in the project files under `issue-36732/` (GitHub image upload is browser-only, so frames are described here):

| Frame | Landed at | Shows |
|---|---|---|
| desktop-01-first-sign-in | `/apps/com.example.showcase/page/showcase_capability_map` | no last-app record: first product app, not a home page |
| desktop-02-no-apps | `/home` | Showcase withheld from both app lists: checklist, then 「No applications yet」 with New in Studio / Start with a template / App Marketplace (no AI agent configured locally) |
| desktop-03-sign-in-last-app | `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/dashboard/system_overview` | Setup opened last: the next sign-in lands there |
| desktop-04-old-home-address | same | typing `/home` lands in the last app |
| desktop-05-deep-link-kept | `/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task` | signed-out deep link survives sign-in |
| phone-01-first-sign-in | `/home` | phone, two apps, no default, no record: the app list, as before |
| phone-02-home-app-list | `/home` | phone `/home` is still 「Choose an app」 |
| item5-desktop-01-business-app-no-checklist | `/apps/com.example.showcase/page/showcase_capability_map` | a business app draws no checklist |
| item5-desktop-02-setup-first-page-checklist | `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/dashboard/system_overview` | Setup's first page: 「Get your system ready」 (3 of 6 done) above System Overview |
| item5-desktop-03-setup-first-page-scrolled | same | scrolled: System Overview at full height below the card |
| item5-desktop-04-other-setup-page-no-checklist | `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/page/connect_agent` | another Setup page draws none |
| item5-phone-01-home-unchanged / item5-phone-02-setup-page-unchanged | `/home`, Setup's System Overview | phone: no checklist on either, as before |
